profile_text.body:
Intel Corp is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, traded under the ticker INTC, with the website intel.com and SEC CIK 0000050863. On its own site the company presents itself under the line "Intel Inside - Built for AI" and says it delivers AI at scale across cloud, data center, edge, and client with hardware and software solutions.

The site also highlights a Googlebook built on what it calls a trusted Intel platform, describing performance, graphics, battery, and connectivity engineered to work as one. Intel's own notices state that its technologies may require enabled hardware, software or service activation, that no product or component can be absolutely secure, that costs and results may vary, and that performance varies by use, configuration, and other factors. The company says it is committed to respecting human rights and to avoiding causing or contributing to adverse impacts on human rights, and that its products and software are intended only for applications that do not cause or contribute to such impacts.

Litigation exposure for the company is recorded in California, where 281 matters are counted.
